sentences.text: Acinetobacter is a bacterial genus found widely in nature, including in soil, water, commercial food products, hospital environmental surfaces and medical devices.
In humans, members of the genus may transiently colonize the skin, the respiratory tract and the gastrointestinal tract, particularly in hospital settings.

The same source describes persistence under adverse conditions such as disinfection and desiccation, and generally low intrinsic virulence, with severe infections in immunodeficient, neutropenic or critically ill patients.
Published descriptions list pneumonia and wound, surgical site, bloodstream and urinary tract infections among reported diseases, often linked to invasive procedures and indwelling medical devices.
The genus has been described as a major reservoir of antimicrobial resistance, and Acinetobacter baumannii has been reported as the species most frequently responsible for human infections.
